Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, document operational procedures, and drive continuous improvement in DevOps standards and practices. Strong experience with Linux administration, command-line tools, Bash scripting, and service management; practical experience supporting macOS build and deployment environments. Experience with Windows environments and PowerShell-based automation for cross-platform software delivery. Proven experience designing CI/CD pipelines covering build, automated testing, packaging, artifact publishing, deployment, and rollback. Experience with Azure services and cloud infrastructure integration for enterprise software delivery. Strong understanding of identity and access management, secrets handling, permissions, secure automation, and software supply chain security. Ability to troubleshoot complex failures spanning source control, build agents, operating systems, networking, application dependencies, and deployment environments. Experience owning infrastructure and automation solutions from design through implementation, rollout, and operational support.
